meaningful.body:
<!-- generated-release-notes v1 -->

## ⚠️ Breaking changes

- Run `upgrade:2-51:migrate-rich-text-to-tiptap` after upgrading to convert existing rich text records to TipTap format. ([#28486](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28486)) by @neo773
- The `blocknote` sub-field on rich text in the GraphQL and REST APIs is now deprecated; switch to `markdown` or `tiptap` before it is removed. ([#28488](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28488)) by @neo773
- Billing plan configuration now lives in the `BILLING_PLANS` environment variable; update your server config. ([#28552](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28552)) by @etiennejouan

## 🌟 Highlights

- Notes, tasks, and rich text fields now use the TipTap editor — one unified experience shared with emails and workflow forms. ([#28487](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28487))
- Run upgrade:2-51:migrate-rich-text-to-tiptap after upgrading to convert existing rich text content to the new format. ([#28486](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28486))
- Exports of 200 records or fewer now download straight to the browser with no background job. ([#26673](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26673))
- Records with a related company now have a Link button on the Emails and Calendar widgets to manually file threads and events. ([#28551](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28551))
- A workflow iterator that fails safely inside a loop no longer re-enters the loop and runs indefinitely. ([#28524](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28524))
- The logs console is now on for every member with the Security permission — no feature flag needed. ([#28481](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28481))

## ✨ New features

- Record filters can now compare a date or number field directly against another field on the same record. ([#28237](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28237)) by @FelixMalfait
- Server admins can now export a complete workspace — including suspended ones — as a zip of CSVs from the admin panel. ([#28480](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28480)) by @charlesBochet
- The logs console is now on for every member with the Security permission; the feature flag is gone. ([#28481](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28481)) by @martmull
- The server now stores rich text in TipTap format, replacing BlockNote as the canonical document format. ([#28485](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28485)) by @neo773
- Notes, tasks, and rich text fields now use the TipTap editor; BlockNote and its packages are removed from the app. ([#28487](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28487)) by @neo773
- AI chat threads with an unsent draft now show a Draft label in the inbox list. ([#28503](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28503)) by @FelixMalfait
- Percentage and boolean fields now have dedicated inputs in record create and bulk-update forms. ([#28510](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28510)) by @charlesBochet
- Records with a related company now have a Link button on the Emails and Calendar widgets to manually file threads and events. ([#28551](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28551)) by @FelixMalfait
- The Microsoft Teams settings page now shows a warning banner when the Teams connection is missing or needs reconnection. ([#28568](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28568)) by @ehconitin
- Sending a campaign to a list larger than the day's remaining email quota is now refused upfront with a clear message. ([#28685](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28685)) by @neo773

## 💅 Improvements & UX

- Exports of 200 records or fewer download straight to the browser; larger exports still use the background queue. ([#26673](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/26673)) by @Weiko
- Autocomplete and Select dropdowns in front components now scroll to reveal the highlighted option. ([#27895](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/27895)) by @bosiraphael
- Dashboards with charts that reference a deactivated field can now be saved without errors. ([#28082](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28082)) by @FelixMalfait
- Agent threads started via the Slack app are now owned by the linked workspace member and appear in the inbox correctly. ([#28193](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28193)) by @abdulrahmancodes
- Custom roles now require the CUSTOM_ROLES billing entitlement; existing role assignments are not affected. ([#28218](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28218)) by @etiennejouan
- XCG (Caribbean guilder) is now available as a currency option. ([#28430](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28430)) by @BOHEUS
- The Companion panel now uses Twenty's shared UI components for consistent styling. ([#28439](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28439)) by @bosiraphael
- Front-end controls, tooltips, and typography now use shared Twenty UI components throughout the app. ([#28441](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28441)) by @bosiraphael
- Call recording and participant widgets now show a slim single-row skeleton while loading, matching Twenty's style. ([#28442](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28442)) by @ehconitin
- Select all in the command menu now correctly passes the full filter to side panel front components. ([#28447](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28447)) by @charlesBochet
- Hover backgrounds behind chip close buttons are removed. ([#28449](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28449)) by @bosiraphael
- Credits in app stats are now truncated: 10 or more show whole numbers, under 10 show two decimal places. ([#28452](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28452)) by @martmull
- App registration statistics now use a two-column grid: installs on the left, credits on the right. ([#28456](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28456)) by @martmull
- Naming a CRM during AI chat setup now restarts the conversation fresh instead of ending at a plain-text dead end. ([#28459](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28459)) by @etiennejouan
- The workflow step editor now saves on a debounce, eliminating the lock-timeout flood that fired on every keystroke. ([#28461](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28461)) by @charlesBochet
- Dropdown menus retain their search text and draft content for the full duration of one open session. ([#28474](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28474)) by @bosiraphael
- Whether a conversation is waiting is now determined in one place in the agent engine, fixing inconsistencies across callers. ([#28499](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28499)) by @FelixMalfait
- Multiple agent runs waiting on a busy conversation now queue in order and run one at a time instead of racing. ([#28506](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28506)) by @FelixMalfait
- PDL enrichment now costs $0.15 per person match and $0.075 per company match. ([#28516](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28516)) by @bosiraphael
- Icons inside flex layouts, including buttons, now keep their requested width and no longer shrink. ([#28523](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28523)) by @bosiraphael
- Banners now support a labeled dismiss button; the Companion notice uses this shared component. ([#28525](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28525)) by @bosiraphael
- Gmail/Calendar, Outlook, and IMAP account apps each have their own cover image on the settings page. ([#28530](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28530)) by @ehconitin
- Calendar event fields restricted by channel sharing now show "Not shared" instead of a raw internal marker. ([#28542](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28542)) by @charlesBochet
- The system filter on Workflows and Agents pages is now a regular filter rule in the filters side panel. ([#28544](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28544)) by @FelixMalfait
- Chart settings dropdowns now use the shared Dropdown components. ([#28545](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28545)) by @bosiraphael
- The AI chat welcome screen, suggested prompts, and composer are now centered in the inbox. ([#28546](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28546)) by @bosiraphael
- The empty Billing Limits tab now explains the available limit types instead of redirecting to the new-limit form. ([#28550](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28550)) by @FelixMalfait
- Inbox rows are refreshed with shared List and Text components, with unread and draft indicators. ([#28564](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28564)) by @bosiraphael
- Your own messages in AI chat now align to the right; reactions, questions, and forms use shared UI components. ([#28566](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28566)) by @bosiraphael
- A member's own AI chat is automatically filed when they leave after reading the last agent reply. ([#28583](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28583)) by @FelixMalfait
- On upgrade to 2.51, settled AI chats already in members' inboxes are filed automatically. ([#28584](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28584)) by @FelixMalfait
- In Claim an application, Sync catalog is now icon-only with a tooltip, and Look up sits at the far right. ([#28615](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28615)) by @martmull
- The Credits used column in app stats is hidden when billing is disabled on the server. ([#28616](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28616)) by @martmull
- Widget and tab settings dropdowns now use the shared Dropdown components. ([#28617](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28617)) by @bosiraphael
- The OAuth consent screen now shows the redirect destination host so you can verify where a connection goes. ([#28619](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28619)) by @charlesBochet
- Workspaces on legacy Pro or Enterprise plans now see their own plan column on Billing Plans. ([#28624](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28624)) by @etiennejouan
- Search controls no longer show blue focus rings. ([#28638](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28638)) by @bosiraphael
- The default role picker in Security settings now only lists roles that can be assigned to workspace members. ([#28644](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28644)) by @prastoin
- Row-level permission rules can no longer be created or updated on non-editable roles such as Admin. ([#28645](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28645)) by @prastoin
- The budget field in the partner brief form is now labeled "Implementation/migration budget range". ([#28650](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28650)) by @ijreilly
- Inbox triage actions stay next to the title and preview in compact 65px rows. ([#28656](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28656)) by @bosiraphael
- The Twenty standard application now has Admin set as its explicit default role. ([#28667](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28667)) by @prastoin
- Currency symbol and amount now render in the same text style on opportunity boards. ([#28676](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28676)) by @bosiraphael

## 🐛 Bug fixes

- Front components and direct file uploads now work behind cookie-authenticating proxies like Google Cloud IAP and Cloudflare Access. ([#28375](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28375)) by @Prashaxt
- Add rule group in a workflow Search Records step now creates the group as expected. ([#28396](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28396)) by @BOHEUS
- Records with long relation table names are no longer incorrectly denied access due to Postgres' 63-byte identifier limit. ([#28411](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28411)) by @ijreilly
- View-derived filters now go through the same validation as other filters, so invalid operators are rejected consistently. ([#28414](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28414)) by @etiennejouan
- Calendar events with no channel association now return masked titles and descriptions instead of real content. ([#28415](https://github.com/twentyhq/twenty/pull/28415)) by @ehconitin

## Changelog

- Automatic conversation translation with Captain or Google Translate. [Enterprise]
- Conversation monitors, AI automation conditions, and label and priority suggestions. [Enterprise]
- Refreshed Captain reports, Copilot chat history, and low-credit alerts. [Enterprise]
- Captain toolset catalog and customer verification for sensitive tools. [Enterprise]
- Email forwarding, subject search, tables, and improved quoted history.
- WhatsApp campaign history, batch sending, and delivery analytics.
- Mobile call ringing, missed-call notifications, and improved Twilio handling. [Enterprise]
- Expanded Companies CRM, company enrichment, and Stripe billing details in conversations.
- Shopify App Store onboarding and billing setup.
- Bulk macros, conversation reading mode, and a collapsible reply editor.
- Editable Help Center article URLs and improved language switching.
- Bearer authentication for existing API tokens.
- Configurable message search windows and auto-resolution schedules.
- Account-wide two-factor enforcement and optional Cloud device verification.
- Redesigned Super Admin with user and email delivery diagnostics.
- Security hardening, dependency updates, bug fixes, and performance improvements.


> Captain V1 has been retired. Self-hosted installations using V1 instructions must migrate them to V2 before upgrading. See the [migration guide](https://github.com/chatwoot/chatwoot/blob/v4.19.0/docs/captain_v1_sunset.md).


> We recommend upgrading to v4.19.0 for the latest security fixes and hardening improvements.


Thanks to @breken-ai, @chiliec, @emilienlefort, @gabrieljablonski, @gihovani, @Kshot3000, @no-hup, @vaibhavmashal, @vivekmiyani, @Will-thom for the contributions.

meaningful.body:
## Changelog


> The Node.js vulnerabilities (notably CVE-2026-111497) did not affect Chatwoot’s production runtime. Node.js is used only to precompile JavaScript assets in the build step; the production application runs on Ruby and does not run Nodejs. We have nevertheless upgraded Node.js as a precaution.

> We recommend upgrading to v4.19.1 for the latest security fixes and hardening improvements.

- Updated Node.js to the 24.22.1 security release.
- Hardened Twilio webhook verification and CSS sanitization.
- Added business hours and withheld caller ID support for Twilio calls. [Enterprise]
- Improved WhatsApp campaign recovery and duplicate-send protection. [Enterprise]
- Added SAML metadata URL support with certificate refresh. [Enterprise]
- Updated Captain AI and transcription models. [Enterprise]
- Added Stripe and auto-translation to paid Cloud plan entitlements.
- Fixed duplicate Help Center articles and conflicting inbox bots.
- Removed unnecessary session cookies from public pages.

Thanks to @xamimran for the contributions.
